title: SELECTION OF 45 RPM RECORDS
reason: Large box of 45s that includes a Beatles Parlophone style EP sleeve, an Apple label single and picture sleeves (McCartney, Alice Cooper); likely $100-200 as a lot (my estimate), more if the Beatles or Apple discs are early Australian issues.
findings: One photo of a deep box of 45 rpm singles and EPs, perhaps 150 to 250 discs, mostly in paper or picture sleeves. Readable items: a blue sleeve reading 'all my ... Beatles' with a small logo block at top left (Parlophone style, text mostly illegible), consistent with the Beatles EP 'All My Loving' but the catalogue number and country are not legible; a black company sleeve with a green apple label disc showing (Apple Records, artist not visible); a Paul McCartney 'Pipes of Peace' picture sleeve; an Alice Cooper 'Billion Dollar Babies' Warner Bros picture sleeve in a plastic bag; a Frank Sinatra Capitol sleeve; and other 1960s and 70s sleeves with illegible titles. Discs and labels are not visible, so pressings and condition cannot be checked. For comparison, an Australian 'All My Loving' EP (GEPO 8891) showed about A$46-55 asking in a search snippet on 19/10/2026 (https://treatsandtreasures.com.au/p/beatles-all-my-loving-ep-record-blue-pc-gepo-8891-au-c2/, page not opened).
condition: Paper sleeves look worn with ring and edge wear, some splits and staining; the plastic bagged Alice Cooper sleeve looks clean; discs not visible so play condition is unknown.
rescore_note: Deep box of perhaps 200 worn 45s with a Beatles All My Loving EP (an excellent AU copy was asked at $47, AUD assumed, at https://treatsandtreasures.com.au/p/beatles-all-my-loving-ep-record-blue-pc-gepo-8891-au-c2/ on 19/10/2026; this sleeve is worn), an Apple label single and a few picture sleeves; discs unseen, so my estimate about $90 to $150 for the lot.
